privileged_info_for_vlm: The procedure must be named MIGRATE_SALES_BULK and reside in the HR schema. It must migrate data from STAGE_SALES_LEGACY to FACT_SALES_PROD. It is required to use BULK COLLECT and FORALL with the SAVE EXCEPTIONS clause. Errors (specifically for 1,063 records with negative values) must be logged to the MIGRATION_ERRORS table, capturing the Sale ID and the error message (SQLERRM). Connection details: User 'hr', Password 'hr123', DSN 'localhost:1521/XEPDB1'.
